title: useMultiStep
description:
Implement a multi-step wizard hook. Steps are 1-indexed. `next()` advances to the next step (clamped at `totalSteps`), `prev()` goes back (clamped at 1), and `goTo(n)` sets the step directly.

**Example:**
```tsx
const { step, next, prev, isFirst, isLast, goTo } = useMultiStep(3);
// step === 1, isFirst === true, isLast === false
next(); // step === 2
goTo(3); // step === 3, isLast === true
```
ai_context: Common mistake: not clamping next/prev at the boundaries, allowing step to go below 1 or above totalSteps. Also: forgetting goTo should also be clamped.
